text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear claim in opening sentence and conclusion","quality":"argumentative focus","description":"The essay states a position early and returns to it at the end, keeping the writing centered on a defendable claim."},{"evidence":"references to construction zones, sensors, cameras, and driver take-over","quality":"textual support","description":"The essay uses specific details from the article to support its point rather than relying mostly on general opinion."},{"evidence":"organized paragraphs on intoxicated drivers, reckless drivers, and pedestrian safety","quality":"reasoned development","description":"The essay builds its case through separate, logically related points that expand the argument across body paragraphs."},{"evidence":"explains how delayed reaction times and road rage create danger","quality":"explanatory depth","description":"The essay goes beyond naming problems by showing how and why those problems make driverless cars seem beneficial."},{"evidence":"mostly complete sentences with fewer distracting errors","quality":"conventional control","description":"The essay has better command of grammar and spelling, which makes its argument easier to follow."}]}
